pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD at each site and level

title: Normalised EMG of 12 trunk sites during right/left axial rotation at 30-100% MVC, standing, males
subcategory: EMG at MVC and submaximal axial rotation

quantity.name: normalised RMS EMG
quantity.definition: RMS EMG over stable 3 s, baseline (minimum EMG in any exertion) subtracted, normalised to the maximum EMG of that muscle in any of the 6 MVCs (flexion, extension, R/L lateral flexion, R/L axial rotation)

source.authors: Ng JK-F, Parnianpour M, Richardson CA, Kippers V
source.sample: healthy right-handed males without history of back pain

protocol.summary: Erect standing in a B200 Isostation triaxial dynamometer (mechanically locked in 3 planes), L5-S1 interspinous space aligned with the flexion/extension axis; pelvis and lower legs stabilised by pelvic restraint, thigh and knee straps; torso fixed by chest restraint and thoracic pad; arms folded across the chest above the chest restraint. MVCs (5 s, 2 min rest) in flexion, extension, right/left lateral flexion and right/left axial rotation with visual feedback; then submaximal right/left axial rotation at 70, 50, 30% MVC (visual target). Torques = mean over stable 3 s, baseline (relaxed standing in device) subtracted; moments measured about the dynamometer axes (flexion/extension axis at L5-S1 interspinous space). Surface electrodes over 6 muscles bilaterally, parallel to fibres; band-pass 5-500 Hz, 1000 Hz sampling.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax restrained
Axial rotation moment right/left at 30, 50, 70, 100% of axial MVC (MVC ≈ 78 Nm)
Extract activation at the 12 named electrode sites (RA, EO, IO, latissimus at T12, iliocostalis at L2, multifidus at L5, both sides)
Normalise each site by its maximum activation over the 6 model MVC directions; compare with mean ± SD
protocol.notes: Iliocostalis electrode level is L2 (checked on page image; OCR text layer reads L7). Points with sd null had the error bar hidden by the marker.
